<h2>Validate an sjSDM Artifact Table</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies an exact column, type, key, row-count, and status contract to one
table nested anywhere inside a v2 cross-validation artifact.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_sjsdm_artifact_table(
  data_value = NULL,
  table_name = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  types = NULL,
  keys = NULL,
  statuses = base::list(),
  n_rows = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_value">data_value</code></td>
<td>
<p>Artifact table.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="table_name">table_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Human-readable payload field name.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="columns">columns</code></td>
<td>
<p>Exact ordered column names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="types">types</code></td>
<td>
<p>Exact named base types returned by [base::typeof()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="keys">keys</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional unique key columns.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="statuses">statuses</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional named list of allowed character values.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_rows">n_rows</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional exact row count.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'TRUE'; invalid tables abort.
</p>
